supplementalBooks.description: Published literary letters; transcribed first edition on Bengali Wikisource

coverageScope: All 3,438 records in RabindraNet's version-2 Bengali NLTR-derived corpus across poetry, song groups, novels, stories, plays, essays and miscellany.
limitations: A source corpus inventory is not proof that every work, manuscript version, private letter or rare word by Tagore is covered.
The research bulk corpus is a 2022 snapshot; additions and corrections to its original NLTR source after that date are not implied.
Records include introductory pieces and dedications; song records may contain groups of songs, so record count is not a count of distinct literary works.
NLTR's introduction says further letters and original English writings are planned; this Bengali inventory does not cover every private letter or English original.
Surface forms include inflections, archaic spellings, Brajabuli, proper names and possible transcription errors; occurrence in literature is not a verified dictionary meaning.
Per-item NLTR node URLs were not retained by the bulk dataset; its items link to the dataset and retain collection title and exact CSV row instead.
Only word counts and source references are distributed; original digitized literary texts remain in the external local cache.
